noaa.definition: n an agency in the Department of Commerce that maps the oceans and conserves their living resources; predicts changes to the earth's environment; provides weather reports and forecasts floods and hurricanes and other natural disasters related to weather

noachian.definition: a of or relating to Noah or his time
noachian.translation: a. 挪亚时代的, 古代的

noah.definition: n. the Hebrew patriarch who saved himself and his family and the animals by building an ark in which they survived 40 days and 40 nights of rain; the story of Noah and the flood is told in the Book of Genesis

noah and the flood.translation: [网络] 诺亚醉酒及献祭；诺亚与洪水；诺亚与洪水灭世

noah webster.translation: 诺亚·韦伯斯特（美国词典编纂家）
